SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_sepsis_septic_h(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	targetq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2q1 int(9)  DEFAULT 0,
	result2q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3q1 int(9)  DEFAULT 0,
	result3q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_sepsis_septic_h WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_sepsis_septic_h 
(
SELECT @id,n.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) targetq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND n.pstatus in(1),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) resultq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) targetq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND n.pstatus in(1),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) resultq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) targetq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND n.pstatus in(1),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) resultq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) targetq4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND n.pstatus in(1),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) resultq4

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(2),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result2q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(2),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result2q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(2),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result2q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(2),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result2q4

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result3q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result3q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result3q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND n.DISCHTYPE  in(2) AND DISCHSTATUS IN(3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.AN),NULL)) result3q4


FROM t_sepsis_septic n
INNER JOIN chospital h ON n.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15)
WHERE  n.DATETIME_DISCH BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
AND SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,4) in('R651','R572') AND DIAGTYPE IN(3)
GROUP BY n.hospcode
);
